title: Design System: ግራጫ ቃጭሎች · Giracha Kachiloch

terracotta.note: Marks the Telegram action and floods the home close. Warm palette chosen by the user on 2026-10-21 over the poster navy/orange.

terracotta-pressed.note: Hover of every terracotta stamp; currently a literal in components, not a :root custom property.

hero-name.purpose: The house name in gold across the foot of the home hero, min(14vw,13rem), no wrap; stacked on two lines at 26vw on phones. Home only.

display.purpose: Page name in ink opening bands, the programme heading and the closing visit heading (type-display).

headline.purpose: Section headings on ink and parchment (type-h2).

title-programme.purpose: Parts of the night on the programme screen: 1.75rem, 2.25rem from 640px, wdth 78.

title.purpose: Recurring heavy-condensed line: wordmark, shelf categories, guest and venue names. Set inline, not a utility; size varies 1.5rem to 1.875rem.

title-small.purpose: List item headings such as support ways (type-h3).

body.purpose: Reading passages at full width, 55 to 62ch on parchment.

nav.purpose: Desktop header links at 0.9375rem; mobile links 0.875rem.

label.purpose: Small uppercase field labels (type-label); tracking resets under lang=am, Latin-only labels carry lang=en.

tagline.purpose: Latin tagline under the header wordmark only: 0.6875rem, 0.2em tracking, uppercase, lang=en.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: Each programme part's 2px gold rule draws across on first paint.

motion.name: part-in
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(10px) to rest, 0.8s, delay i*140ms+250ms

motion.name: poster-drift
motion.value: 40px/s linear, endless loop over a duplicated track
motion.purpose: Past-night posters drift right to left; pauses on hover, touch (4s), focus, open poster or the pause button; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: portrait-reveal
motion.value: 500ms ease-out: wash fades, grayscale/sepia to 0, scale 1.03
motion.purpose: Guest portraits warm to original colour on hover.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover on buttons, links, poster panels.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations none, scroll-behavior auto, no poster drift
motion.purpose: All content visible and still without motion.

paletteHistory.decision: User chose the warm house palette (parchment, ink, gold, terracotta) over the poster navy/orange; typography kept unchanged.

narrative.overview:
The site is set like the printed programme handed out at one of the club's evenings, printed on warm parchment in espresso ink. Ink fields carry the opening screens and the posters; parchment carries the longer reading passages; gold carries the house name, the info strip and the programme's rules; terracotta marks the Telegram action and floods the home page's close. A woven tibeb band, the border of Ethiopian cloth that also frames the club's printed shelf sheets, stitches each dark opening to what follows. Display type runs heavy and condensed like the poster lettering, in both Ethiopic and Latin, while body text stays at full width for reading.

The user chose this warm house palette (parchment, ink, gold, terracotta) on 2026-10-21. It replaces the poster navy and orange of the first build. The type system is unchanged.

Structure comes from rules and baselines, not from boxes. Running orders, shelf lists, guest captions and the support list each hang from a 2px rule (ink on parchment, gold on ink) and are divided by hairlines. Images are the exception to the no-box rule: real photos, posters and shelf sheets sit in rounded panels, and the one horizontal strip of colour blocks (the info bar) is lifted directly from the foot of the club's posters.

Amharic leads and English is complete. Both scripts share one stack per role (Archivo for Latin, Noto Sans Ethiopic for fidel), so mixed text picks the right face per glyph without per-language styling.
keyCharacteristics: Ink fields and parchment sections alternate down every page; the home page opens on a full-screen room video and closes on a terracotta field.
Heavy condensed display type on the variable width axis (wdth 70 to 82); the house name runs in gold at near full-screen width.
A woven tibeb band marks the hand-over from each dark opening, and tops the footer.
Text rides 2px rules and hairline dividers; there are no card boxes around text.
Photos, posters and sheets sit in rounded panels (1rem, 1.75rem for feature images).
Terracotta belongs to the Telegram action; on ink fields the primary action turns gold.
Motion is slow and stoppable: programme rules draw in, past-night posters drift, portraits warm to colour on hover.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Terracotta marks the Telegram action. It appears as the stamp in the info bar and as the field of the home close that ends on that action; there the Telegram button flips to a parchment pill with terracotta text. Outside the action, terracotta appears only as the woven accent inside the tibeb band. Never use it for headings, outlines or a second, unrelated action.

rules.name: The Gold-on-Ink Rule
rules.body: A primary action sitting directly on an ink field is a gold pill with ink text, hovering to parchment. Terracotta lacks the contrast to stand out against ink, so it is not used for buttons there.

rules.name: The Warm Pairs Rule
rules.body: Every text pairing clears WCAG AA: parchment or sand on ink and ink-deep, ink on gold, parchment or cream on terracotta, parchment on gold-deep, white on terracotta, ink and ink-soft on parchment. Do not put sand or cream on parchment, or parchment on gold.

rules.name: The Fidel Tracking Rule
rules.body: Ethiopic has no case and tracking pulls its syllables apart, so any uppercase, label or tracked text under lang="am" resets to normal letter-spacing. Latin-only labels inside Amharic pages (the header tagline, English name lines) carry lang="en" so they keep their tracking.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by weight and the wdth axis together; display roles never run at full width, body never runs condensed.

rules.name: The Printed Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separate things with colour bands, rules, the tibeb and space, never with shadows.

dos: Do alternate ink fields and parchment sections; open every inner page with an ink band and the page name at Display, finished by a tibeb band.
Do hang lists and captions from a 2px rule and divide items with 20% ink hairlines.
Do put photos, posters and sheets in rounded panels (1rem, 1.75rem for feature images) on an ink backdrop.
Do run display roles condensed on the wdth axis (70 to 82) and keep body at full width.
Do tag Latin-only labels with lang="en" so the Ethiopic tracking reset does not strip them.
Do give every control at least a 44px target.
Do make the primary action on an ink field a gold pill with ink text; keep the Telegram stamp terracotta on the info bar and a parchment pill on the terracotta close.
Do give any moving element a pause control, pause it on hover, touch and focus, and stop it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use terracotta for anything but the Telegram action, the close that ends on it, and the tibeb's woven accent.
Don't put a terracotta button on an ink field.
Don't wrap text in card boxes, borders or tinted containers; the info bar is the only colour-block strip.
Don't add box shadows or floating elevation.
Don't letter-space or uppercase Ethiopic text.
Don't use the tibeb between two parchment sections or as a frame around content.
Don't add motion beyond the programme's rule-draw and settle, the poster row's drift, and the portrait colour reveal.
